name: Robot Mechanism Design
summary: Turning robot requirements into hardware: arm, hand, leg and mobile-base architectures, link and joint design, and lightweight structures.

topics.name: Robot requirements and kinematic architecture selection
Serial arm design: link sizing, mass distribution and stiffness
Parallel robot design: workspace and singularity optimisation
Gripper and robotic hand design (underactuated and tendon-driven hands)
Legged robot mechanism design: leg topologies, energy efficiency and impact tolerance
Wheeled and tracked mobile platform design
Joint design: bearings, seals, cable routing through joints, slip rings
Lightweight robot links (composites, additive manufacturing, topology optimisation)
Safety by design and collaborative-robot mechanics
